ideas.name: any warning ending a light-volume side
ideas.why: a trend that ran on below-normal volume (the 1m MACD side's average relative volume under 0.9) had few committed traders; it turns more easily

ideas.name: any warning ending a small move
ideas.why: if the 1m MACD side moved price under one 5m ATR, there is little to give back, and the warning calls a turn in a drift that was never a trend

ideas.name: any warning on an inside bar
ideas.why: a bar inside the one before is a pause: neither side pressing, the moment a trend stalls before it turns

ideas.name: any warning with a 5m row warning the other way
ideas.why: a 1m warning while a 5m row warns the opposite turn is the two timeframes disagreeing about where the trend is; the 1m one has the slower chart against it
